rules.a_m: the player's kills per map on map m: map_player_stats k, sideid 0 (total), joined to match_maps (matchid, mapstatsid) and maps, over maps of matches dated in [match day - window_days, match day); a map with fewer than min_maps_on_map such maps uses his overall per-map average over the same window
rules.chance: kills: one normal at the projection with the live spread (sd = c x sqrt(max(projection, 1)), c = live sd / sqrt(max(live lambda, 1))), the live cut rule, P(Over | no push), capped to [1 - kills_cap, kills_cap]; HS: the kills pmf at the kills projection with the live kills spread (perf.kills_c), beta-binomial HS (kappa 100) at the live HS per kill, P(Over | no push), uncapped
rules.control: C0-pooled = the same arithmetic at his overall per-map average over the same window x maps in the prop (no map weighting)
rules.map1: Map 1 props: a_m of the likeliest simulated veto's (rank 1) first map in step order whose action is picked or leftover
rules.snapshot: map_chances (the scraper's latest read) only when every row was updated before the earlier of the forecast's match start and HLTV's listed start; map_chances_history is never read
rules.weighting: Maps 1-2 / Maps 1-3 props: sum over every map HLTV lists for the match of chance_m x a_m / sum of chance_m, times maps in the prop
